verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote, quote mark and attribution together as one block and puts the can and its circle at bottom right, like the original. Its flaws: the logo floats in mid-left space with no shared edge, the attribution is nearly as heavy as the quote, and the can label is unreadably small. B squeezes the quote into a narrow five-line column with choppy breaks, drops the logo into the top-right corner where it competes with the quote, and strands the attribution at the bottom, far from its quote. The page reads as scattered fragments.
